name: MODE_VIEW_MENU
desc: VIEW menu: Left/Right choice -> album grid (mode 0A) or slide-show menu (mode 0B)

name: MODE_SPECIAL_MENU
desc: Special menu: vertical 2-way choice -> mode 1A or 17

name: MODE_ALBUM_EDIT
desc: Album viewer with the edit pages (the guide's Album: Paint / Stamp / Frame / Comment / Print / Delete)

name: MODE_ALBUM_VIEW
desc: VIEW album: pick a photo then browse with a slider and edit pages

name: MODE_HOT_SPOT_VIEWER
desc: Photo grid then the photo with the pointer hand

name: MODE_SLIDE_SHOW
desc: Slide-show hub; options and auto-play viewer

name: MODE_DELETE_PHOTO
desc: Delete which photo? (also used for the Copy item of the Album editor: states 0C / 0E)

name: MODE_SHUTTERBUG_MAGIC
desc: SHUTTERBUG menu (TRICK LENSES / MONTAGE / PANORAMA / GAME FACE)

name: MODE_HOT_SPOT_EDITOR
desc: Select photo / edit the five hot spots

name: MODE_PRINT_PHOTO_PICKER
desc: Print one photo (picker; layout; density; border)

name: MODE_PRINT_JOB
desc: Print job state machine (the data transfer screen; TV with dancing figures); also called Transferring in the README

name: MODE_COUNT
desc: number of modes: the mode table `00:2F3F` has 34 entries; `cp $22 / jr c` accepts a table entry as a mode, anything above is refused

name: MODE_NONE
desc: no target: the *_TargetModeTbl tables hold $FF for an item that leads nowhere (the caller stays in its state)

name: SNDCH_SFX1
desc: channel byte 1 of a sound list: the id goes to the request mailbox of effect 1 (Snd_PlayFromList 00:2A4B)

name: SNDCH_MUSIC
desc: channel byte 2: the id goes to the song mailbox

name: SNDCH_SFX3
desc: channel byte 3: the id goes to the request mailbox of effect 3

name: SNDCH_SFX4
desc: channel byte 4: the id goes to the request mailbox of effect 4
